title: Фильтрация Данных (Торможение)
description: Торможение неверных реакций: поиск грамматических ошибок. В каждом предложении есть ошибка в грамматике Present Simple (форма глагола, do/does, окончание -s). Найди и исправь её.

items.text: My friend go to school by train every day.
We watches TV in the evening.
Does he plays computer games after school?
My parents works in a big office.
Teenagers uses the Internet every day.
He don’t do his homework at night.
Do your sister listens to music in the morning?
My teacher give us tests every Friday.
They doesn’t go to the sports centre.
The bus arrive at eight o’clock every day.
I doesn’t live in the city centre.
Our classmates studies French at school.
Does your parents work at the weekend?
She go to bed very late on weekdays.
